title: Poble Sec · Carrer de Blai
description: Poble Sec from OpenStreetMap (just geo-build poble-sec): out of the L3 in Plaça dels Ocellets, Carrer de Blai's slabs, bars and terraces under the festoons, Emilie's corner on Carrer de Margarit, the top of Margarit where the street turns into stairs up Montjuïc, a cross street climbing towards Elkano, and the overview with the slope behind the roofs. The last shot reads the draw calls following Gerard and in the overview.

steps.caption: Plaça dels Ocellets: out of the L3, where Blai meets the Paral·lel
Carrer de Blai: slabs from wall to wall, bars side by side, terraces and festoons
Emilie's corner: the narrow wedge where Carrer de Margarit leaves Blai
Mirar el portal: Gerard looks up at her balcony
Up Carrer de Margarit: past Elkano the street turns into stairs, terraces of houses and Montjuïc's pines
Carrer del Poeta Cabanyes: a cross street climbing from Blai towards Elkano, balconies close overhead
Top of Creu dels Molers: the first stone terrace of Montjuïc, its stair and the houses above
Overview (R): Blai across the middle, the cross streets climbing to Elkano and Montjuïc rising behind the roofs
